rationale: Both are well-evidenced, diff-grounded reviews, but Y digs deeper into the Ref2VA theme that dominates the ground truth (restart command fails against the documented download pattern, 2-GPU OOM risk, undocumented audio_reference shape), which echoes the human reviewer's 'have you tested ref2va' concern that surfaced a real bug. Y also lands a genuinely deep major finding (the memory-model fit conflates Ulysses degree with text-encoder-TP scaling, which are collinear across the sweep) plus a sharp self-contradiction catch (the doc's own formula refutes its 'no further reduction past eight GPUs' claim) that X only treats as a wording nit. X is tighter and slightly safer per-claim (all validated, mostly minor/nit), but is shallower and misses these higher-value issues, so despite reasonable precision it covers less ground.
